findings.highlight: even though the weather should be warm
findings.evidenceJa: 暖かいはずの冬木の気候
findings.governingReading: The recent cold is anomalous specifically against Fuyuki’s normally warm climate.
findings.explanation: The omitted place name detaches the weather anomaly from Fuyuki’s established local climate.

findings.evidenceJa: しもやけで真っ赤になった手
findings.governingReading: The remembered person taught with hands reddened by chilblains after playing in the snow.
findings.explanation: Frostbite is a different and potentially severe freezing injury, exaggerating the bodily harm.

findings.highlight: this time, I’m naked as well. Even though I’m confused, my body is reacting.
findings.evidenceJa: 今回はやる気に満ちているというか、こっちも似たような格好で、かつ、混乱してるっていうのに体は反応してしまっていた
findings.governingReading: The explicit bodily-reaction sentence is commented out and replaced by a brief statement that this occasion goes beyond the previous one.
findings.explanation: One English branch restores and rewrites the deleted adult-version reaction instead of following the active source.

findings.highlight: Saber watches as I stand there dumbfounded.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは凍り付いたように見つめている
findings.governingReading: Saber stares at the confused Shirou as though she herself has frozen.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou dumbfounded and removes Saber’s frozen quality, reassigning the bodily state.

findings.highlight: while backing up towards the dressing room
findings.evidenceJa: じりじりと脱衣場に下がりながら
findings.governingReading: Shirou inches backward toward the changing room while making excuses.
findings.explanation: The English omits the slow, incremental retreat that contrasts with the dash he refuses to make.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに見惚れていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou denies being captivated by Saber.
findings.explanation: One English branch narrows his involuntary fascination to her body, adding an explicit object absent from the source.

findings.highlight: Then, I merely desperately felt Saber’s skin.
findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも身近にあった、セイバーの温かさが蘇る
findings.governingReading: The memory revives Saber’s warmth from when she was overwhelmingly close in the ruins.
findings.explanation: One English branch replaces recalled warmth and proximity with awkward new narration about desperately feeling her skin.

findings.highlight: I couldn’t see Saber’s body in the dark.
findings.evidenceJa: 弱々しく、華奢だったセイバーの体
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers Saber’s body as weak and delicate.
findings.explanation: One English branch substitutes an unsupported claim about darkness and visibility, erasing the physical vulnerability he remembers.

findings.highlight: I only remember her warmth and her sensations.
findings.evidenceJa: 重ね合った体温と鼓動
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers their overlapping body heat and heartbeats as mutually shared physical signs.
findings.explanation: Her sensations assigns inaccessible subjective feeling to Saber and removes Shirou’s heartbeat and the mutual overlap.

findings.highlight: the body I’ve once obtained is so beautiful
findings.evidenceJa: 今はその全てに、抗いがたいものを感じている
findings.governingReading: In the present, everything in that memory exerts a force Shirou finds difficult to resist.
findings.explanation: One English branch invents possession of a body he “obtained” and a beauty judgment, replacing the source’s unresolved attraction.

findings.highlight: Saber hangs her head in embarrassment.
findings.evidenceJa: 恥ずかしそうに俯くセイバー
findings.governingReading: The explicit narration of Saber bowing her head in embarrassment is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted emotional staging.

findings.highlight: She claims her body is rugged
findings.evidenceJa: 体が硬いっていうけど
findings.governingReading: Saber describes her trained body as hard or stiff, a quality Shirou says never bothered him.
findings.explanation: Rugged suggests rough appearance or outdoor toughness rather than bodily hardness.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉もないほど、セイバーの体は女の子
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds Saber’s body so unmistakably that of a girl that words fail him.
findings.explanation: Really feminine flattens the speechless intensity and changes concrete girlhood into an abstract feminine quality.
